title: Infinity — Follow every thought
excerpt: A free AI app for Mac. Ask anything, then follow any part of the answer into its own branch. Every path stays where you left it.
content_html:
Infinity
Chat / Code / Assistant / Models / Features
Download

An AI app for your Mac

Ask anything, then follow any part of the answer into its own branch. Every path stays where you left it.

Free / Version 0.1.5 / macOS 14 or newer / Apple silicon and Intel Now in early testing

∞branches from every answer

4models answering at once

10+providers, on your Mac or in the cloud

0accounts, ads or analytics in the app

Most chats move in a single line. Infinity lets every answer branch, so you can follow a thought as far as it goes and still find your way back.

Animated demos of the Infinity Mac app. Chat: a question gets an answer, Infinity asks a few smart questions, a selected phrase opens in a split pane, another phrase opens a second pane, and the Canvas shows every branch. Code: an idea becomes a plan, then a working app with a live preview, then a change made on a draft copy. Assistant: a morning brief, a trip planned by the Atlas assistant, an approval before saving a file, and a weekly schedule.

Chat / Going deeper

Infinitely deep.

Every answer opens another. Infinity keeps the whole path, so going deeper never means losing your place.

One app.
Three ways to work.

Switch with ⌘1, ⌘2 and ⌘3. Projects are shared across all three, so nothing needs explaining twice.

01 / Chat

Every answer leads somewhere.

Branch from any phrase, ask up to four models at once, and get charts and tables when a picture is clearer.

…an effect called Rayleigh scattering, so blue light…

Fork ▾ExplainGo deeperCounterpoint

02 / Code

Infinite tries. One clean history.

Describe an app or open a folder. It runs beside the chat, and every change is a save point you can go back to.

Save point 4Shopping listCurrent Save point 3Add itemsGo back to here Save point 2First screen

03 / Assistant

Always working. Always asks first.

Assistants you message like contacts, with their own memory and schedules. They ask before doing anything you haven't allowed.

Needs you Writer wants to save the weekly update. AllowNot now

04 / Projects

One project. Every way of working.

A project keeps its chats, code, files and memory together. Hand a chat to an assistant or turn it into code, and everything it needs comes along.

And so on,
and so on.

All of it is in the app today, free.

Chat

  • Fork from any phrase
  • Six routes under every answer
  • Side pane or continue below
  • Read and Canvas views
  • Ask up to four models
  • Charts, tables and checklists
  • Tap-to-answer questions
  • Projects, archive, temporary chats
  • ⌘K to jump anywhere

Code

  • Start from an idea, a folder or GitHub
  • Build, Plan first or Just ask
  • Save points with Go back to here
  • Explain and Change this on draft copies
  • Live preview with Point
  • Code, Changes and Terminal
  • Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi
  • Secrets with Test and Live values
  • Put it live on Vercel, Netlify and more

Assistant

  • Assistants you message like contacts
  • Own instructions, model, folder, voice
  • Memory you can read, edit and undo
  • Groups with a lead
  • An inbox for approvals
  • Automations on a schedule
  • Your day, a morning brief
  • Calls, out loud
  • Teams shared as one file

Models and Mac

  • Ollama, LM Studio, Apple Intelligence
  • OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and more
  • Your ChatGPT plan through Codex
  • Models by job
  • Images with FLUX.2 or Image Playground
  • Search your folders by meaning
  • Code runs in a sandbox
  • Native SwiftUI, light and dark
  • Updates itself, signed by Apple

Private
by default.

No accountNothing to sign up for, and no analytics in the app.

On your MacChats, settings and the file index stay here.

In your KeychainAPI keys are stored by macOS, with your passwords.

Straight to the sourceMessages go directly to the provider you chose, with your key.

Read the privacy note

There’s always another question

Download, drag into Applications, pick your models.

Animated demos of the Infinity Mac app. Chat: a question gets an answer, Infinity asks a few smart questions, a selected phrase opens in a split pane, another phrase opens a second pane, and the Canvas shows every branch. Code: an idea becomes a plan, then a working app with a live preview, then a change made on a draft copy. Assistant: a morning brief, a trip planned by the Atlas assistant, an approval before saving a file, and a weekly schedule.
